rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something typical or representative of a person or thing.

example.english: This is the most characteristic style of a Hong Kong cha chaan teng.
example.traditional: 呢個係最典型嘅香港茶餐廳風格。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 zeoi3 din2 jing4 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 caa4 caan1 teng1 fung1 gaak3

rows.note: Use this when the characteristic is distinctive or unusual rather than merely typical.

example.english: This little shop has a very characteristic interior.
example.traditional: 呢間小店嘅裝修好獨特。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 duk6 dak6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a notable characteristic or feature.

example.english: The biggest characteristic of this phone is that it is really light.
example.traditional: 呢部手機最大嘅特點就係夠輕。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 dak6 dim2 zau6 hai6 gau3 hing1

rows.note: Use this for a distinguishing feature, especially one that identifies a person or thing.

example.english: Their most obvious characteristic is that they speak very fast.
example.traditional: 佢最明顯嘅特徵係講嘢好快。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 ming4 hin2 ge3 dak6 zing1 hai6 gong2 je5 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for a characteristic quality or trait, especially a person's mental or behavioural quality.

example.english: Being patient is a rare characteristic.
example.traditional: 做人有耐性係一種好難得嘅特質。
example.jyutping: zou6 jan4 jau5 noi6 sing3 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 naan4 dak1 ge3 dak6 zat1

rows.note: Use this for an inherent property or characteristic of a thing, particularly in technical or explanatory contexts.

example.english: A characteristic of this material is that it expands when heated.
example.traditional: 呢種物料嘅特性係遇熱會膨脹。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 mat6 liu6 ge3 dak6 sing3 hai6 jyu6 jit6 wui5 paang4 zoeng3
